ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity (white/cream) to low-intensity (black/grey) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity contiguous blobs located on the upper distal lobes. Low-intensity pixels form a central wedge and a wide border along the entire trailing edge and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 65 degrees and a bounding-box depth relative to the fluke horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations across the entire trailing edge; distinct high-amplitude peaks (5-15 pixels) present towards the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave-to-convex transition with a sharp upward sweep ending in pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast circular clusters (barnacle scars) detected on the lower left-mid fluke and densely packed on both distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel vertical high-intensity lines on the lower central dark region; diagonal low-intensity linear marks on the upper right high-intensity lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular trailing edge degradation and heavy calcified colonization/scarring on the distal tips; multiple sets of rake marks across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent isolated dark focal spot located in the upper-right quadrant within the high-intensity region.
